server.note: The harness spawns and stops its own Dock dev server. Ports 3000/3001 belong to another local project and are never bound, probed or killed. The hub URL points at a reachable hub in live-hub mode, so data-backed screens are measured on their live branch. This run's hub is an ephemeral in-process instance, not the deployed one.
